notice: Demo templates for testing software mechanics only. Illustrative documentation dimensions; not clinical guidelines, not exhaustive, not mandatory, and not a standard of care. Must be reviewed by a qualified clinical advisor before any real-world use.

templates.description: Illustrative documentation dimensions for a patient-reported headache.
templates.source: TraceCare hackathon demo (Section 13 of the project blueprint)
templates.disclaimer: Demo template, not a clinical guideline. Items are illustrative and not mandatory questions.

items.label: Onset
items.description: When the headache started or first appeared.
example_questions: When did it start?
When did you first notice it?

items.label: Duration / course
items.description: How long it has lasted and whether it has changed.
example_questions: How long has it been going on?
Has it changed over time?

items.label: Location
example_questions: Where do you feel it?

items.label: Description
items.description: How the patient describes the feeling.
example_questions: How would you describe the feeling?

items.label: Severity / impact
items.description: How severe it is or how it affects daily life.
example_questions: How severe is it?
How does it affect your day?

items.label: Frequency / pattern
items.description: How often it happens or any timing pattern.
example_questions: How often does it happen?

items.label: Triggers / relieving factors
items.description: What makes it better or worse.
example_questions: Have you noticed what makes it better or worse?

items.label: Other symptoms mentioned
items.description: Any other symptoms discussed alongside the headache.
example_questions: Have you noticed anything else?

templates.display_name: Musculoskeletal pain (back / joint) — consultation documentation demo
templates.description: Illustrative documentation dimensions for patient-reported back or joint pain.
templates.disclaimer: Demo template, not a clinical guideline. Items are illustrative and not mandatory questions.

items.label: Onset (when it started)
items.description: When the pain started or how long it has been present. A question about injuries alone is not an onset question.
example_questions: When did it start?
How long have you had this pain?

items.label: Injury / what started it
items.description: Any injury, accident, or activity that started the pain (including an explicit denial of injury).
example_questions: Did you injure it?
What were you doing when it started?

items.label: Location
example_questions: Where exactly is the pain?

items.label: Description
items.description: How the patient describes the pain.
example_questions: What does the pain feel like?

items.label: Severity / impact
items.description: How severe it is or how it affects activities.
example_questions: How bad is the pain?
Does it stop you doing anything?

items.label: Aggravating / relieving factors
items.description: What makes it better or worse.
example_questions: Does anything make it better or worse?

items.label: Previous episodes
items.description: Whether similar pain or problems happened before (history of similar episodes).
example_questions: Have you had this before?

items.label: Treatment tried so far
items.description: Anything the patient has already tried for this pain, including medication taken (e.g. a question about current medication answered with a painkiller), ice, rest or heat.
example_questions: Have you tried anything for it?
Are you taking any medication for it?

items.label: Other symptoms mentioned
items.description: Any other symptoms discussed alongside the pain.
example_questions: Any other symptoms?
